notes.title: Minor Update (V1.47)
notes.content: - Gambler perk purchases are now saved if the game is closed before starting a run.

notes.title: Minor Update (V1.46)
notes.content:
- Powerup cards now only appear in the Abyss.
- The skull key card has been removed since its usefulness was rather limited.
- Increased the pitch variance range for certain sound effects.

notes.title: Minor Update (V1.45)
notes.content:
- Added alternate ways to unlock new characters.
- The dragon boss now takes place on floor 10 and the murky depths floor has been removed. This is done to improve pacing by reducing the time commitment between runs while also removing one of the duller levels.
- Rebalanced enemy stats and other parameters somewhat.
- Tier 5 xp gems can now appear in treasure vaults.
- Enemys can now drop tier 5 gems in the abyss.
- Recolored the Warlock's main attack to a more fitting hue.
- Adjusted the transparency of soul projectiles.
- Cracked walls highlights are now enabled by default.

notes.title: Minor Update (V1.44)
notes.content:
- The in-game gold counter now includes gold rewards gained from defeating enemies and completing floors.
- Reworded certain level card descriptions for better clarity.

notes.title: Minor Update (V1.43)
notes.content: - Fixed a bug where upgrades would display incorrect values when near the corresponding cap.

notes.title: Minor Update (V1.42)
notes.content:
- Reduced shop cost of Cursed Dragonfire.
- Fixed range value error for Surge projectiles.
- Fixed incorrect sprite rotation after bouncing for Surge projectiles.

notes.title: Hotfixes (V1.41)
notes.content:
- Fixed some typos and incorrect damage/speed values on various soul mods.
- Fixed a bug that caused soul projectiles to not work properly in certain co-op situations.
- Added some directional variation to Truefire (was meant to be in V1.4).
- Spawners no longer fire bullets while outside of camera bounds.

notes.title: Leveling Changes & Soul Cards (V1.4)
notes.content:
- Added new "Soul" cards. These are passive attacks that provide extra damage and can be upgraded and modded at level 5. Each player can have 2 soul attacks. Note that soul attacks can not destroy enemy projectiles, objects, or crit. Soul upgrades also come with a 50% free roll chance.
- Stats and upgrades have been "squished". While levels take longer to reach, upgrades are now much more potent.
- Shop stats are now only buyable up to tier 5 instead of 10, but they ultimately have the same price and effect. If you had points invested into them before this update, your gold will be refunded and you will need to rebuy the upgrades.
- Weapons now have a max level of 5 instead of 10, and are moddable at level 5.
- The Elf's alt attack projectiles now do damage and are destroyed if they hit an enemy before being launched.
- The Skull Key card now turns all remaining keys into treasure chests.
- Rebalanced enemy stats.
- Various other small tweaks and bug fixes.

notes.title: Special Card Fixes (V1.31)
notes.content:
​- Added a one card per level limit for powerup cards.
- Powerup and ability cards now come with a 50% chance to reroll after selection.
- Powerup cards will no longer appear if there are no enemies on the floor.
- Frenzy cards will no longer appear until you have at least 10% crit chance.
- Reworded the skull key description to clarify that it opens any door on the current floor.
- After a mana burst, xp gems are now automatically collected.
- Slightly increased the overall roll chance of special cards.
- Fixed a bug that prevented manastruck cards from appearing at max mana.
- Fixed a bug that could cause the game to crash when stats were capped.

notes.title: Leveling & Difficulty Changes (V1.3)
notes.content:
- Added a new dynamic difficulty system. The game now automatically adjusts the difficulty between floors based on a variety of factors, mostly relating to skill level. This feature is subtle and will generally have the biggest impact on players who are either very good or very bad.
- Dynamic difficulty does not affect the abyss, instead abyss enemies now become stronger over time.
- Added new special cards to leveling. Special cards are rarer than the standard weapon and stat cards, and include upgrades to bonus chance, rerolls, boosts, cursed cards, powerups, and more. More special cards will likely be added in the future.
- Reroller can now be upgraded to tier 5 in the shop menu.
- Reduced EXP needed to level up.
- Various other minor tweaks and bug fixes.

Note: Will probably be tweaking the difficulty system over time, post your feedback if it's giving you trouble. :)

notes.title: Minor Update (V1.24)
notes.content:
​- Added a new halo effect to torches.
- Fixed a calculation error with the speed stat, speed upgrades should have a bit more impact now.
- Re-balanced the fairy's healing ability.
- Adjusted the pitch variation of certain sounds.

notes.title: Minor Update (V1.23)
notes.content:
V1.23
- Added pitch variation to various sound effects to reduce audio fatigue.
- Miniboss elites now only spawn from elite spawners.
- The fairy now heals players periodically.
- The Phoenix Feather flame trail now has higher damage scaling.
- Some players may notice improved performance.

notes.title: Minor Update (V1.22)
notes.content:
- The Ring of Fortune now triples loot drops, but only applies to mimics and treasure thieves.
- Increased the cap on how much loot thieves can drop when the Ring of Fortune is active.
- The Dark Dragon now fires a few more red projectiles and alternates its purple/pink projectiles.
- Increased the amount of gems dropped by dragons.

notes.title: Elite Hotfixes (V1.21)
notes.content:
​- Reduced cost of the Elite Skull to 1000 and updated the sprite to be more "elite".
- Fixed a bug where incorrect enemies would spawn in the abyss in elite mode.
- Fixed a bug where certain enemies would have incorrect sprites in elite mode.
- Fixed a rare crash that was possible only in elite mode.
- Fixed improper gold values displaying in the relic shop.

notes.title: New Elite Mode! (V1.2)
notes.content:
- Added the Elite Skull to the relic shop. When purchased, this will replace ALL enemies with elites.
- Consolidated the Gold and Snarky skulls into one. The Gold Skull now grants 4 relic slots, but increases enemy health by 50% and enemy damage by 25%.
- Fixed a bug where elites wouldn't fire projectiles on the Dark Dragon floor.
- Fixed a bug that caused enemy projectiles to move slower on lower framerates.

notes.title: Elite Spawner Hotfixes (V1.18)
notes.content:
- Elite Spawners no longer drop five gems, instead they now drop a single higher tier gem.
- Added a new diamond gem, for now these are only dropped by elite spawners and dragons.
- Fixed a bug that prevented Elite Spawners from spawning certain enemy types.

notes.title: Elite Spawners & Regen Buffs! (V1.17)
notes.content:
- Added new Elite Spawners, which have double HP and fire purple projectiles.
- Critical Frenzy now doubles critical chance instead of granting 100%.
- HP and MP regen upgrades now grant +3% per upgrade tier, up to +15% for a +5 upgrade. The caps for each have also been raised to +180%.
- Vitalized and Spiritual in the shop now give +3% regen per tier.
- Base HP/MP regen rates have been reduced slightly.
- Slightly increased the amount of XP needed for level ups after level 100.
- Various other small tweaks/bug fixes.

notes.title: Minor Update/Bug Fixes (V1.16)
notes.content:
- Reduced the base volume of all sounds and music by 20%.
- Fixed missing tiles and shadows on some maps.
- Fixed incorrect damage/other values of various weapon modifiers in co-op.
- Fixed a bug in co-op where having 2 or more paladins/priests would break their weapon modifiers.
- Fixed a rare bug that caused certain projectiles to get stuck in walls.

notes.title: Minor Update (V1.15)
notes.content:
- Changed Death's Boon to a single tier purchase that prevents death from appearing, but reduces bonus chance by 20%.
- The Book of Death can no longer be purchased if Death's Boon is active.
- Enemy spawners no longer spawn enemies when a player is nearby.
- Added an option for player 1 to use keyboard/mouse as their input device in co-op. This will assign pad 1 to player 2, pad 2 to player 3, ect.
- Added a very brief period of enemy projectile invincibility after a player is damaged by them, this is to prevent unexpected stack damage.

notes.title: More Modifier Tweaks (V1.14)
notes.content:
- Adjusted damage values for Knight, Trapper, Vampire, and Psythe modifiers.
- Corrected some incorrect range values of ranged modifiers for the Swordsman and Psythe.
- Fixed a bug that caused Paladin and Priest modifiers to not work right in co-op.
- Fixed a bug that broke the Merchant's Double Coin modifier.
- Fixed a pathing bug with followers/minions.
- Powerup relics are now even less likely to appear while active.

Note: The weapon modifier list in the guides section has been updated to reflect this.

notes.title: Weapon Modifier Tweaks (V1.13)
notes.content:
- Reduced the damage penalty on most of the speedy weapon modifiers.
- Reduced the damage penalty of the Warrior's Double Boomerang modifier.
- Corrected an incorrect range value on the Warrior's Ranged Boomerang modifier.
- Renamed certain weapons and modifiers to have more consistent naming.

Note: The weapon modifier list in the guides section has been updated to reflect this.

notes.title: Minor Update (V1.12)
notes.content:
- Stat level ups now always cap at 60 and caps are no longer extended by shop upgrades.
- Standard enemies and spawners no longer fire projectiles when the player is nearby (about 2 tiles).
- Adjusted certain maps that had very rough starts.
- Corrected some typos from the V1.1 update.
- Fixed a bug with the Knight's Double Sword modifier that caused it to affect the shield too.

notes.title: Minor Update (V1.11)
notes.content:
- Cracked wall highlights now flash brighter and faster.
- Added "Highlight Cracks" to the options menu (it is unchecked by default).
- Removed "Auto Attack" from the options menu (it is still toggleable in-game with "R" by default, or "R Bumper" by default on gamepads).
- Fixed a bug that caused the vampire's bat form to not gain speed while attacking.

notes.title: Major Update - New Weapon Modifiers and More! (V1.1)
notes.content:
- New weapon modifiers! At weapon level 10, you can now choose between one of 3 modifiers. Modifiers allow you to alter things like projectile count, base damage, base speed, range, ect.
- Cracked walls now flash yellow to make them easier to see.
- Changed the color of the Warlock's main attack from red to green.
- Reduced the attack speed scaling of Gnome minions.
- Powerup relics are now less likely to drop while they are active.
- After spawning, enemies will now wait a few frames before moving.
- Mimics no longer appear on the dragon floor.
- Slightly reduced the chance of enemies spawning from pots.
- Death ate too many donuts and is now 50% bigger.
- Dragons now fire new pink projectiles, making them harder to cheese. ;)
- Added an option to lock aim control to the right stick for gamepads.
- Fixed a calculation error that caused attack speed benefit to scale incorrectly after 100%.
- Fixed a bug that caused dark dragonfire to not damage the player.
- Added new "full curse" categories to the Steam leaderboards.
- The "Completion Time" and "Abyss Survival Time" Steam leaderboards have been reset, the old leaderboards are now archived as (legacy) leaderboards.
- Various other small tweaks and bug fixes.

notes.title: Small Update (V1.08)
notes.content:
- Death no longer appears on the dragon floor.
- Fixed an issue that caused incorrect icons to appear on the level up screen.

Notes: A new​ major update is in the works, which will add weapon modifiers and more! ;)

notes.title: Hotfix (V1.07)
notes.content:
​- Fixed an error that broke the timing on enemy spawners.
- Also, recolored the shamans on floor 3 to make them easier to differentiate.

notes.title: Small Update (V1.06)
notes.content:
- Enemy fire rates now slowly scale (increase) to their pre-V1.05 values and beyond based on floor progression.
- Enemies are now slightly faster in later floors.
- Slightly increased enemy projectile speeds to make up for their new acceleration.
- Fixed some issues with the new trail effects.

Note: This update is mostly meant to offset some changes that affected difficulty in V1.05. In general, runs should be slightly easier in early floors and slightly harder in later floors (relative to V1.04).

notes.title: Small Update (V1.05)
notes.content:
- Added new trailing effects to player attacks.
- Added new (minor) post processing effects.
- Added some initial acceleration to enemy projectiles.
- Death's Boon now delays Death's arrival by 2 minutes per tier.
- Increased the likelihood of finding relics in treasure rooms.
- Reduced the projectile fire rate on spawners and basic enemies.
- Slightly reduced enemy move speed.
- Slightly reduced the enemy spawn rate of spawners.
- Slightly reduced the spawn chance of mimics.
- Slowed down the speed of floating text.
- Various other small tweaks and fixes.

notes.title: Small Update (V1.04)
notes.content:
- Enemy movement and projectile speed has been reduced slightly.
- Mimic spawn chance has been reduced to 25% (from 30%).
- Reaper now deals crit (x2) damage with all attacks.
- Various other minor tweaks/fixes.

notes.title: Small Update (V1.03)
notes.content:
- Enemy movement and projectile speed has been reduced slightly.
- Improved some of the maps.
- Gold bags now appear randomly in the final stage.
- Fixed some minor UI display bugs.

notes.title: Small Update (V1.02)
notes.content:
- The game now pauses when focus is lost during gameplay.
- Fixed a few minor UI-related bugs.

notes.title: Small Update (V1.01)
notes.content:
- The mouse is now hidden when navigating menus with the keyboard.
- Fixed a bug that made the Gnome's alt attack cost more mana than intended.

notes.title: Small Update (V0.99)
notes.content:
- Improved some of the older maps.
- Added a new title screen background.
- Updated the credits.
- Fixed a bug that cause the game to crash when manual level up was enabled.
- Various other small tweaks/bug fixes.

notes.title: Content Update (V0.98)
notes.content:
- Added 5 new maps to the map pool (50 total).
- Improved some of the older maps.
- Various other small tweaks/bug fixes.

notes.title: Content Update (V0.97)
notes.content:
- Rebalanced the pricing of relics.
- Death now deals more damage to enemies while the book of death is active.
- Added 5 new maps to the map pool.
- Improved some of the older maps.
- Various other small tweaks/bug fixes.

notes.title: Content Update (V0.96)
notes.content:
- The Paladin's and Trapper's alt attacks no longer damage walls.
- The MP cost of the Gnome's alt attack has been increased to 15.
- Improved some of the older maps.
- Added 10 new bonus maps.
- Added a new "Enemies Defeated" leaderboard.
- Various other minor tweaks/bug fixes.

notes.title: Hotfix (V0.95)
notes.content:
- Changed the behavior of the Psythe's alt attack, it can now deal a lot more damage but costs a bit more MP.
- The credits now play after completing any type of run.
- Fixed a bug where the credits wouldn't play properly.
- Fixed a bug that caused the wrong title screen music to play.
- Various other small tweaks/fixes.

notes.title: QOL Update (V0.94)
notes.content:
- Relic descriptions can now be viewed in the pause menu.
- Random relics can now be found in treasure rooms with a limit of 4 per run.
- Items you pick up will now be collected while fading to the next floor.
- Attacking while auto attack is active now suppresses your attacks.
- Powerup bars now prioritize whichever is most important if more than one are active.
- Fixed manastruck not working if the player didn't have enough MP.
- HP and MP restoring cards are now replaced with gold cards if HP/MP is full.
- Dragonfire can now ignite the Dwarf's alcohol.
- Pots now have a chance to spawn an enemy when destroyed.
- Various other small tweaks/bug fixes.

notes.title: Small Update (V0.93)
notes.content:
- Fixed up certain maps where it was easy to warp directly into a group of enemies.
- Changed base HP regen from 5 seconds to 4 seconds.
- Slightly increased the invincibility window granted after warping and opening doors.
- There is now a short delay before you can open a door after warping.
- Fixed a major bug with AI pathfinding in co-op.
- Various other small tweaks/bug fixes.

notes.title: Content Update (V0.92)
notes.content:
- Added a new ending/credits sequence and a one time reward for defeating the dark dragon.
- Various other small tweaks/bug fixes.

notes.title: Co-op QOL Update (V0.91)
notes.content:
- Removed the 25% enemy health increase from co-op mode.
- Slightly increased the likelihood of rolling higher tier stat upgrades in co-op.
- Each player's crosshair in co-op now match their respective colors.
- Added a new timer bar that displays when a powerup is active.
- Various other minor tweaks/bug fixes.

notes.title: 4 Player Co-op Update! (V0.9)
notes.content:
- Added a new 2-4 player local co-op mode!
- Added a new Steam leaderboard for total runs completed.
- Redid the gamepad inputs menu and improved some other UI elements.
- Enemy projectiles now deal slightly less damage.
- Improved cursed dragonfire visibility.
- Fixed a bug that caused the fairy to spawn even when the relic wasn't checked.
- Several other small tweaks/bug fixes.

notes.title: Content Update (V0.82)
notes.content:
- Added 5 new maps to the map pool.
- Added 5 new bonus maps.
- Duplicate bonus maps will no longer appear more than once per run.
- Added 1 new achievement to the Steam version.
- Various other small tweaks/bug fixes.

notes.title: Hotfix (V0.81)
notes.content: - Fixed a bug that caused the Cursed Dragonfire flame to appear even when the shop upgrade wasn't active.

notes.title: Content Update (V0.8)
notes.content:
- Added the Gambler shop upgrade, which lets you bet on the success of your next run.
- Added the Cursed Dragonfire shop upgrade.
- Added the Dark Ritual Tome relic, which grants an opportunity to fight a new superboss.
- Added new particle FX to various attacks.
- Added 4 new achievements.
- Various other small tweaks/bug fixes.

notes.title: Content Update (V0.71)
notes.content:
- Added 5 new maps to the map pool.
- Added 2 new bonus maps.
- Added 4 new achievements for the Steam version.
- Added additional input options for gamepads.
- Gold rewards now grant more gold, but are no longer affected by gold rate.

notes.title: Content Update (V0.7)
notes.content:
- Added the Renewal upgrade to the shop, which grants a single revival per run.
- Added the Relic Shop upgrade to the shop, which lets you purchase various relics before a run.
- Added a fix to the Elf's alt attack that helps prevent it from getting stuck in walls.
- Stunned enemies now display a new FX graphic above their heads.
- Slightly reduced the base move speed of enemies and their projectiles.

notes.title: Content Update (V0.64)
notes.content:
- Added a post-game gold reward based on floors completed and enemies defeated.
- Added 5 new maps to the map pool.
- Added 2 new bonus rooms.
- Key markers will now point to the exit after collecting all keys.
- Treasure thiefs now drop treasure based on how much they've collected.
- The number of completed runs (victories) per class is now displayed in class selection.
- Note that past victories (before this update) will not be counted.
- Reduced the base damage of all enemy melee attacks by 20%.
- Slightly lowered the damage of the dwarf's fires.
- Improved the AI of Gnome minions.
- Changed the way the Elf's alt attack works.
- The MP cost of the Vampire's alt attack is no longer affected by dex when not attacking.
- The Vampire's bat form is now always an instant transformation.
- Reduced the number of shots that fire from the Wolfman's shotgun, but also tightened the spread.
- The Psythe's main attack no longer gets stuck on walls or insta-breaks cracked walls.
- Various other small tweaks/fixes.

notes.title: Hotfix (V0.63)
notes.content:
​- Rebalanced and fixed some issues with certain classes, including the Dwarf, Gnome, Elf, & Vampire.
- Changed the way damage works in preparation for an upcoming co-op mode; damage amount is now set when a projectile is created, rather than being persistent.

notes.title: Content Update (V0.62)
notes.content:
- Added 6 new classes, the Dwarf, Gnome, Elf, Vampire, Wolfman, and Psythe.
- Added 8 new achievements to the Steam version.
- Added a purple outline to boss monsters to improve their visibility.
- Added a very short period of invincibility after unlocking doors.
- Lowered the attack speed of the Archer's alt attack.
- Fixed a minor memory leak issue.
- Various other small tweaks/bug fixes.

notes.title: Hotfix (V0.61)
notes.content:
- Adjusted teleporter placement on certain maps to make them more playable, esp on later floors.
- The staying time for the Trapper's traps has been changed from 1 minute to 30 seconds.

notes.title: Content Update (V0.6)
notes.content:
- Added a post-game stats menu.
- Added the twin thieves, who will attempt to steal all the treasure in treasure vaults.
- Added 4 new shop upgrades, including rerolling, stat boosting, and a way to delay death.
- Added 4 new community-designed maps to the map pool (thanks to DMPDesign and Wolfman11983).
- Added 4 new classes: the Ninja, Trapper, Warlock, & Gladiator.
- Added 5 new achievements.
- Added a goofy new interaction to the title screen. ;)
- When launching on Steam deck, the game will now always start in fullscreen mode.
- Fixed a bug in colorblind mode where symbols would sometimes not display correctly.
- Made several other small tweaks/bug fixes.

notes.title: Small Update (V0.53)
notes.content:
- Improved the onboarding experience for new players. First time players will now spawn in a set map that teaches basic controls in an open space and will require breaking a cracked wall to continue. Completing floor 1 for the first time will also grant a free bonus room.
- Added some RNG rigging for bonus rooms. A free bonus room will be granted if the check is failed 5 times in a row, guaranteeing at least 2 bonus rooms per run.
- Lowered the base volume of all sounds and music by about 30%, volume settings may need to be re-adjusted to desired levels if they were previously changed.
- Fixed a bug that caused the final boss' shadow to not display correctly.
- FIxed various other very minor bugs.

notes.title: Small QOL Patch (V0.52)
notes.content:
- Added 10 new achievements, one for completing each floor.
- HP and MP are now fully restored when moving between floors, this is so that players are no longer encouraged to wait around and regen before moving on to the next floor.
- Potions no longer appear in bonus rooms, and tier 3 potions have been removed from the game.

notes.title: QOL Update (V0.51)
notes.content:
- Improved readability and feedback for certain UI elements.
- The shop button will now flash yellow if you've collected gold in a previous run.
- Brightened the coloring for several crosshairs to make them stand out better.
- A colorblind mode can now be enabled in the options menu, this will display differentiating symbols on all doors.
- Added a tutorial for basic controls to assist new players.
- Keys you don't currently possess now appear grayed out on the HUD.
- Health and mana regen upgrades now affect regen interval instead of the amount.
- Added a brief period of invincibility after teleporting (0.5 seconds).
- The movement speed of enemies and their projectiles has been reduced slightly.
